request.question: Who must approve a DTI exception for a customer whose total exposure would be USD 40,000?

response.answer:
Relevant policy text (extractive mode, no LLM):
- Every exception requires approval one authority level above the level that would normally approve the exposure, with a minimum of Level 2. [1]
- The total unsecured exposure of a customer across all Meridian Bank products (personal loans plus card limits plus overdraft limits) must not exceed USD 75,000. [2]
- DTI limits may be exceeded by at most 5 percentage points through an approved exception under MB-POL-005. [3]

contexts.doc_title: Credit Policy Exceptions and Approval Authority Policy
contexts.section: 3. Policy Exceptions > 3.3 Exception Limits and Required Approver
contexts.text:
Every exception requires approval one authority level above the level that would normally approve the exposure, with a minimum of Level 2. Additional limits apply:

- DTI may be exceeded by at most 5 percentage points.
- Loan amounts may exceed the risk grade cap by at most 20%.
- No more than one exception may be granted on a single application; applications that need two or more exceptions must go to the Retail Credit Committee.
- LTV exceptions also require Collateral Committee approval under MB-POL-003 section 6.

contexts.doc_title: Personal Loan Limits and Pricing Policy
contexts.text:
Risk grades use the Meridian Risk Score table defined in MB-POL-001 section 3.1.

| Risk grade | Maximum loan amount (USD) | Maximum DTI | APR band |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 50,000 | 45% | 7.99% to 11.99% |
| B | 35,000 | 45% | 12.00% to 16.99% |
| C | 20,000 | 40% | 17.00% to 23.99% |
| D | 7,500 | 35% | 24.00% to 29.99% |
| E | Not eligible | Not applicable | Not applicable |

The DTI calculation includes the new loan installment. DTI limits may be exceeded by at most 5 percentage points through an approved exception under MB-POL-005.

contexts.doc_title: Credit Policy Exceptions and Approval Authority Policy
contexts.text:
Approval authority is based on the customer's total exposure after the new credit, including all existing Meridian Bank limits and balances.

| Authority level | Role | Maximum total exposure (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Level 1 | Senior Credit Analyst | 10,000 |
| Level 2 | Credit Manager | 50,000 |
| Level 3 | Head of Retail Credit | 150,000 |
| Committee | Retail Credit Committee | Above 150,000 |

Credit Analysts below the Senior level have no individual approval authority; their recommendations must be approved by a Level 1 or higher approver.

contexts.doc_title: Credit Policy Exceptions and Approval Authority Policy
contexts.text: An exception is any approval that does not meet a requirement of MB-POL-001, MB-POL-002 or MB-POL-003, for example a DTI above the limit, a loan amount above the risk grade cap, or an LTV above the maximum.
